title: Sessions overview shows '0 working' while delegations (review pairs, evaluators) are running, because hidden delegation children no longer count anywhere
outcome:
Reported by Greg at about 16:19Z on 2026-11-24, relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2648). His Sessions overview showed "0 working / 103 completed / 3 errors", and he asked why nobody was working.

Facts, from Fable2's read-only check:
- The team's root sessions were idle, waiting on delegations: Opus3's round-34 review pair on w-56f3 c47 was running at that moment.
- Since w-314a5d481df3 landed (fbc6fd0c), delegation children are excluded from the main Sessions list, which is correct and wanted. As a side effect their activity no longer appears in the overview counts, so real work looks like no work.

Wanted: the overview shows running delegations without listing them as sessions. For example, a "N delegations running" count, or a parent row marked as waiting on N delegations. Greg should be able to tell "idle because waiting on delegations" from "idle with nothing in flight". w-314a's rule stays: delegation rows stay out of the Sessions list.
acceptance: Sessions overview shows '0 working' while delegations (review pairs, evaluators) are running, because hidden delegation children no longer count anywhere is done
